operative_context: The system shall ensure availability changes are applied immediately when relevant rental lifecycle events or availability controls are updated.
The system shall update availability in real time when rent records are created, modified, cancelled, or completed.
## 4.2.3 The system shall ensure availability queries reflect the latest rent and item status information.
Availability restrictions and maintenance periods take precedence over normal availability and prevent rent creation during restricted or maintenance periods.
Availability queries must reflect the latest rent and item status information at query time.
The system shall automatically update availability status when rent lifecycle events occur.
exceptions: Availability restrictions take precedence over normal availability (4.3.3).
Maintenance periods block rental activity and mark items as unavailable during those periods (4.4.1-4.4.3).
Authorized users can define and modify availability restrictions and maintenance periods.
conflicts_or_obsolete: An earlier implementation discussion suggested using a single fallback delay after certain rental events, but this conflicts with the current requirement for immediate availability updates (E4 developer note).
